Synopsis:
    A meeting between Iran and Gulf states is scheduled for Monday in Oman to discuss the Strait of Hormuz, but no signed agreement is expected. Iran seeks to collect transit fees from ships using the strait, which Oman rejects. The backdrop is volatile: the US and Israel attacked Iran in February, triggering war; both the US and Iran have fired on tankers in the strait; and Iran-aligned Houthis are advancing near the Bab el-Mandeb. Global oil prices have surged in the past week. The diplomatic meeting is exploratory, not conclusive.
